jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. As a key member of Anduril s recruiting team, you will be responsible for the company s talent management as we continue to rapidly grow. Your work will be hands-on and involve collaborating with leaders and individual contributors to define the hiring needs of the company. To achieve this, you will be given the autonomy and tools to execute on our strategy to build and develop Anduril s world class team. We are looking for someone who can handle high levels of ownership while tackling every aspect of recruiting and is excited to be part of team where no task is too big or too small.  We are searching for a Senior Recruiter who will be working directly with hiring across our UK Operation. jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote in Latin America. About the Role As our Technical Recruiter, you'll specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment and own hiring from intake to offer. That includes our hardest searches, Senior and Principal AI Engineers, plus our regular full-stack, front-end and back-end roles. You'll know the AI engineering market well enough to tell a mid-level from a senior, from a principal before they reach our interview team. You'll also use AI tools to source and run searches better than a manual process can. That covers intake, sourcing, screening, scheduling, feedback, debriefs and offers. jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. jobs.title: Working Student - Talent Acquisition
jobs.description: Please read the required qualifications carefully and note that full business-level fluency in German & English is a requirement. Your role The industry is referring to a "war for talent". There has never been a time when the right people were more in demand and more valuable than it is today. We are truly in the people economy, which means that recruitment is not only crucial but also a significant competitive advantage. To lead this change, we rethought recruitment. As a working student, you will be a part of the creative and high-performing Talent Search (TS) Team, one of three core processes of Netlight. Your main responsibility will be around active sourcing, application management, recruitment , and other processes related to the growth of Netlight. You will get insights into the whole recruitment process, from the first contact to a world-class onboarding of our new colleagues into Netlight. jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
